items.jp: 母と一緒に市場に行った。

市場に is the destination of the completed past trip.
Do not add an unspoken subject such as 我.
semantic_unknowns: The source does not name the traveler or say why they went.

stable: Same companions, together phrase, destination noun, and completed past trip as adopted jz004.
changed: The destination particle is に instead of へ.
limits: Do not require a different Chinese destination word just because the Japanese particle changed.
